# React RSS Template

This is a React + Vite template for creating customizable RSS aggregators.

## Tech Stack
- React 19 with TypeScript
- Vite for build tooling
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- rss-parser for RSS feed parsing
- GitHub Pages for deployment

## Project Structure
- `src/components/Feed.tsx` - Main RSS feed component
- `src/App.tsx` - Main application layout
- `tailwind.config.js` - Tailwind CSS configuration
- `postcss.config.js` - PostCSS configuration
- `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` - GitHub Actions deployment workflow

## Development
- Run `npm install` to install dependencies
- Run `npm run dev` to start development server
- Run `npm run build` to build for production
- Run `npm run preview` to preview production build

## Deployment
The project is configured to automatically deploy to GitHub Pages when changes are pushed to the main branch.
